The blocking states, each with its primary fix: revoked, expired, version too old, version too new, and channel not entitled. Each state names what happened and what to do, never a raw code.

## In each kit

<Tabs syncKey="ui-kit">
  <TabItem label="Terminal (Python)">
    **Drop-in.** `status` when the gate blocks: the title, the message and the fix as a command.

    **Styled part.** `screens.gate(kit, view)` in `polaris_key.ui.terminal`, drawn with a `Kit`; restyle through
    `Theme(colors=…, symbols=…, preset="native")`.

    **Headless.** `gate_view(status, …)` → `GateView(component="StatusScreen")` in `polaris_key.ui.core.models`.

  </TabItem>
